evals.prompt: Character: elite lawyer, publicly ruthless, privately can't sleep. Map flaw, ghost, and need.
evals.expected_output: Flaw-Ghost-Need triangle with specific behavioral flaw, credible backstory wound, and a need distinct from surface want; notes on how it drives scene choices.

evals.prompt: Two siblings reunite after 10 years. One became a priest, one a smuggler. What do they want in the scene vs what do they need?
